description: Returns the full verified spec record for one product, looked up by slug, model number, other model number or name, with its source URL and check date. Recalled power banks are returned with their recall notice.

category.description: Optional. Limits the lookup to one category, for when a model number or name matches products in more than one. One of: "chargers", "power-banks", "usb-c-cables", "mini-pcs", "kvm-switches", "usb-c-docks", "ssds", "nas", "wireless-chargers", "monitors", "memory", "power-supplies", "cpu-coolers", "graphics-cards", "video-cables", "ethernet-cables", "pc-power-cables", "usb-cables". No default (all categories). Example: "chargers".

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

product.description: Required. The product to look up: its slug, model number, another model number it is sold under, or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). If more than one product matches, the error lists the candidates. Example: "A2687", "anker-prime-160w" or "Anker Prime 160W".

name: get_product
title: Get one product
